details: Central bankers affirm gold's role as a strategic reserve asset, citing concerns over rising government debt and geopolitical instability. Despite a 4% dip this year due to surging bond yields, central bank buying and safe-haven demand have kept prices above $4,000. This underscores ongoing global economic and political uncertainties that can influence investor sentiment across all asset classes, including cryptocurrencies.
title: Gold Retains Key Safe Haven Status Amid Geopolitical Instability

details: Bitcoin's price climbed above $87,000 following a US jobs report indicating weaker-than-expected growth (29,000 jobs added in September vs. 84,000-93,000 forecast). This softened expectations for aggressive Federal Reserve interest rate hikes, generally boosting risk-sensitive assets like Bitcoin. This development suggests that a more dovish stance from the Fed, prompted by economic data, could be favorable for cryptocurrency valuations.
title: Bitcoin Surges Past $87,000 on Weaker US Jobs Report

details: SEC Commissioner Hester Peirce, known as "Crypto Mom" for her pro-digital asset stance, concluded her tenure on October 2, 2026. Her departure occurs as the SEC continues to advance major crypto rulemakings on custody, token classification, and market structure. Her absence removes a significant voice advocating for clearer crypto regulations, which could introduce some uncertainty into the regulatory landscape.
title: Crypto Advocate Hester Peirce Departs SEC Amidst Ongoing Rulemaking

details: Morgan Stanley is establishing a Digital Asset Lab in 2026 to explore blockchain applications, specifically focusing on tokenization, settlement, and custody. This initiative reflects growing institutional interest and infrastructure development in the digital asset space. This move by a major financial institution signals increasing mainstream acceptance and integration of digital assets, which is a positive long-term indicator for the crypto market.
title: Morgan Stanley Launches Digital Asset Lab for Tokenization and Settlement

details: Facing high demand for computational power, Bitcoin mining companies are increasingly repurposing their extensive infrastructure, including power and cooling systems, to host AI data centers. This strategic pivot offers new and more stable revenue streams for crypto-related businesses. This diversification indicates innovation within the crypto industry and potential for new growth avenues, which could indirectly benefit the broader crypto ecosystem.
title: Bitcoin Miners Leverage Infrastructure for AI Data Centers
